ssot_note: NOT AN SSOT. This file is the MACHINE-READABLE PROJECTION of the human-readable governance source. Where this file and `starq governance.txt` disagree, the governance text wins and this file is drift, reported as drift and never silently reconciled.

provenance.contract_source: Room seq 8488 - @antigravity, COMPANY OS CONTRACT V1

g1_acceptance.channel: Founder instruction to @opencode, 2026-10-03, treating the Founder's approval of the skyscraper brief as the G1 architecture acceptance required by Room seq 8488
g1_acceptance.note: Recorded so the build's authority provenance is auditable rather than assumed. G1 is a reserved Founder decision; no agent and no tooling can supply it.

prose_is_not_authority.detail: No value in this file is derived by parsing free-form governance text at runtime. Every field here is DECLARED. A reader that cannot find a declared value reports UNKNOWN; it never falls back to interpreting a sentence. This is a structural property of the loader, not a convention.

authority_model.rule: A SEAT IS A FUNCTION, NOT A POWER
authority_model.authority_binds_to: the Founder and applicable company doctrine
authority_model.detail: Creating, renaming or occupying a seat confers no authority. Acting capacity records WHICH seat an occupant is exercising in a given action; it never widens what that occupant may decide. Delegation records who may EXECUTE beneath a seat; delegated execution is never authority. No agent becomes a corporate officer by appearing in this file.
authority_model.builder_is_verifier: ENFORCED — no agent may independently accept its own work. This is a standing gate in the Room and is not expressed here as a permission.

company.incorporation_note: Not declared in any canonical source read by Command. Absence of a registration record is reported as UNKNOWN and is never read as either incorporated or unincorporated.

primary_occupant.note: One human occupant currently fills many distinct organizational seats. That does not make the seats the same role. See AGENTS note on acting capacity.

company.structure_note: The company organization exists above; the engineering organization exists below. Dev Studio is ONE floor of this building, not the building.

founder.handle_note: `ali` is a legacy alias of `mustarq`; both resolve to the same ROOT_GENESIS authority identity. Neither is a separate person.
founder.current_acting_capacity_note: NOT DECLARED. The architecture brief (section 13) lists EXAMPLES of acting capacity, not a declaration of the current one. No canonical source records which seat the Founder is exercising right now, so Command reports UNKNOWN and renders the available capacities as a menu, never as an active hat. Supplying one here would be Command inventing authority - exactly what it must not do.
founder.acting_capacity_authority_effect: NONE - acting capacity is a record of which seat is being exercised. It never creates, widens or transfers authority.
founder.reserved_note: These are RESERVED, meaning no agent, surface or delegated execution may exercise them. This list is a constraint on the system, not a grant to the Founder.

shared_infrastructure.name: Starq Command
shared_infrastructure.owns: Organizational visibility, seat/occupant mapping, capacity, evidence, Founder attention, system health, project state
shared_infrastructure.note: Command renders canonical truth. It does not manufacture authority and it is not a source of it.

shared_infrastructure.name: Herdr
shared_infrastructure.owns: Launch, PTY/process ownership, authoritative PID/runtime state, launchability, process identity, runtime truth
shared_infrastructure.note: Herdr answers whether a process actually exists. Command never claims runtime truth for a process Herdr owns.

shared_infrastructure.name: Room
shared_infrastructure.owns: Assignments, handoffs, Founder rulings, accept/reject events, durable communication history, evidence trail
shared_infrastructure.note: The Room is the coordination and evidence spine. A claim without Room evidence is an assertion, not a record.

shared_infrastructure.name: Jev
shared_infrastructure.owns: Repository reconnaissance, file/path discovery, task classification, seat ranking, cheap routing assistance, triage, prioritization, offload advice
shared_infrastructure.operating_order: Hard constraints / authoritative state -> Jev -> Elder / Command / Founder judgement
shared_infrastructure.note: Jev is INFRASTRUCTURE, NOT STAFF. It holds no seat, is not an L1 seat and is not an occupant of anything. It must never appear in a seat count, a headcount or an org chart as a person or officer.

seat_states.OCCUPIED_HUMAN: Filled by a non-Founder employee or contractor.
seat_states.DELEGATED_AI: Execution beneath a seat is assigned to the digital workforce. The SEAT still has a human occupant; the delegation is what is automated.
seat_states.VACANT_UNFILLED: An established organizational seat that is currently unstaffed. It exists, and it is honestly empty.
seat_states.FUTURE_DORMANT: A gated initiative. Established in the structure, deliberately not operational.

floors.name: Governance / Founder Office
floors.purpose: Company existence, ownership, capital, reserved decisions, final company direction, strategic commitments, constitutional rules, appointment of operating authority.
floors.note: These are not DevOps roles. They sit above the operating company.

floors.name: Corporate Administration & Finance
floors.purpose: Establishing and maintaining Starq as a real legal and financial entity.

floors.name: Executive Management / C-Suite
floors.purpose: Executive decision domains for the two distinct business activities.
floors.note: Starq Technologies and Starq Dynamics are separate decision domains even though the current occupant is the same person.

floors.name: Dev Studio
floors.purpose: Primary technology-production floor. Large enough to contain its own internal rooms and operational functions.

floors.name: AI Engineering / Digital Workforce
floors.purpose: The delegated execution capacity of the company: 5 Paid L1 seats and 5 Free/Offload seats.
floors.note: This is capacity, not command. No agent here is an officer of the company; each executes beneath a seat held elsewhere. Paid L1 capacity is scarce and should be protected - routine or mechanical work is offloaded where practical to free/support seats.

floors.name: Starq Dynamics / Commercial Operations
floors.purpose: The business-services operating activity. Commercial owner of the Hoadhaa merchant relationship.

floors.name: R&D
floors.purpose: Evaluation of AI agents, local models, Hermes, orchestration, StarqNexus, Command, Herdr, Jev, memory and company-brain systems, alternate coding agents, automation systems, new developer tools and UI frameworks.

rooms.name: Starq User Account
rooms.purpose: Universal identity/account layer for all Starq services.

boundary.rule: Hoadhaa has TWO organizational owners and one technology product. Conflating them is how a commercial relationship gets mistaken for an engineering task, or the reverse.
boundary.source: Room seq 8487 (Founder); skyscraper brief section 7 Room 3 and section 10

rooms.note: starqERP implementation is ON HOLD under DEC-100. That is a room STATE and is not a system fault; runtime and projection claims remain separately qualified.

rooms.note: Must not render as active, staffed or operating. The entity condition is unmet and is stated, not assumed away.

rooms.name: StarqPay

rooms.note: Must not be treated as an active operating payment business.
